description: Descope authentication and user management platform with no-code flows

config.setupInstructions:
1. Log in to your Descope console (https://app.descope.com).
2. Copy your Project ID from Settings → Project → Project ID.
3. Go to Settings → Company → Management Keys and create or copy a key.
4. Paste both values below.
